sections.label: Expanding PUB plumber licensing scheme
sections.summary: The Bill expands PUB's licensing scheme for water service plumbers to include sanitary plumbers under the revised Licensed Plumber scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Bill will expand PUB's current licensing scheme for water service plumbers to include sanitary plumbers under the revised Licensed Plumber (LP) scheme.

sections.label: Six-month transitional period for plumbers
sections.summary: The Bill provides a six-month transitional period from the effective date of the LP scheme for incumbent plumbers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To ease the change to the LP scheme for incumbent plumbers, the Bill provides for a six-month transitional period from the effective date of the LP scheme.

sections.label: Existing plumbers qualified as LPs
sections.summary: 96% of the 863 existing plumbers, either PUB's LWSPs or SPS-registered plumbers, are already qualified to be LPs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: To date, 96% of the 863 existing plumbers, who are either PUB's Licensed Water Service Plumbers (LWSPs) or plumbers registered with the Singapore Plumbing Society (SPS), are already qualified to be LPs.

sections.label: Expanding water regulation and DWU powers
sections.summary: The Bill expands regulation to drinking water provided in business and to the public, and gives DWU officers entry and investigation powers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The Bill seeks to close this gap by expanding the regulatory scope to cover all water suitable for drinking that is provided in the course of business, and to the public, except for water that is already regulated by other agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Besides this, DWU officers will be provided with powers, similar to those that PUB officers already have, to enter premises to conduct investigations of water quality incidents, which will enhance the DWU officers' response time in dealing with such incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Upon receiving feedback from the public, PUB will first investigate and, if they determine that the issue is caused by a failure of the technical integrity of the water supply, PUB will then take action against the appropriate party.

sections.label: PUB powers over dangerous cargoes
sections.summary: The Bill gives PUB powers to regulate transport of dangerous cargoes and board vessels to investigate offences protecting reservoir and waterway quality.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: For instance, the Bill provides PUB with the powers to regulate the transport of dangerous cargoes as well as board vessels to investigate offences so as to protect water quality in our reservoirs and waterways.

sections.label: Flint Michigan lead contamination case
sections.summary: The passage cites the Flint, Michigan contamination case where lead from ageing pipes leached into the water supply.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: One example is the contamination case in Flint, Michigan, in the United States where lead from ageing pipes leached into the water supply.

sections.label: Licensing plumbers for competent homes
sections.summary: The speaker supports the Bill to license plumbers, including sanitary plumbers, so home owners are assured of competent plumbing work.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We need to get people who are competent, and with proper training and knowledge, to ensure that all homes are well-served.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I fully support the Bill which seeks to license the plumbers, including sanitary plumbers, so that the home owners can be assured that they have competent people doing the plumbing works or repairs.

sections.label: Transition period and HDB PUB control
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether the six-month transition period is sufficient and whether HDB and PUB will ensure only licensed plumbers do plumbing works.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: First, the transition period, the six-month transition period: is this sufficient?

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Next, will the Housing and Development Board (HDB) and PUB exercise stricter control over our renovation contractors and ensure that only licensed plumbers are allowed to carry out plumbing works?

sections.label: Licensed plumbers passing jobs to unlicensed
sections.summary: Some local plumbers said that some licensed plumbers pass on jobs to unlicensed plumbers after getting the jobs.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Some local plumbers told me that some licensed plumbers would pass on the jobs to unlicensed plumbers after getting the jobs.

sections.label: Qualifying for new LP licence
sections.summary: Under clause 21, existing LWSP licensees with SPS registration automatically qualify for the new LP scheme, while others have until 30 September 2018 to qualify.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Under clause 21 of the proposed amendments in this Bill, those who are licensed under the existing LWSP scheme and who also hold the SPS registration certificate, will automatically qualify for the new LP scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: The rest of the practising plumbers would have until 30 September 2018 to bring their necessary qualifications up to par to qualify for the new LP licence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: That will entail attending sanitary and water service plumbing courses conducted by PUB, as well as to pass an assessment test.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: The courses and assessment are on top of attaining a baseline BCA Builder Certificate course in Plumbing and Pipe-Fitting or equivalent.

sections.label: PUB certification in specialised areas
sections.summary: The speaker hopes PUB can do more by giving plumbers certification in specialised areas, as many may not be trained in this work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: You will realise that many of them may not be trained in this area of work.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: So, while I commend the Bill for spelling out the licensing requirements of the licensed water and sanitary plumbers, I hope the PUB can do more by giving them certification in specialised areas.

sections.label: Senior plumbers may lose jobs
sections.summary: The speaker is concerned that senior citizen plumbers may be deprived of their jobs if they have difficulties learning the required skills to get certified.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: My concern is that in our bid to upgrade industry standards, these plumbers, who are senior citizens, may inadvertently be deprived of their jobs if they have difficulties learning all the required skills to get certified.

sections.label: Builder Certificate Course cost
sections.summary: The Builder Certificate Course is subsidised under the mid-career enhanced subsidy but still costs over $600, which is hefty for the low-income and needy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: The cost of the Builder Certificate Course is significantly subsidised under the mid-career enhanced subsidy.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, it still comes up to over $600, a sum which is hefty to the low-income and needy.

sections.label: Plumber licence training deadline
sections.summary: The speaker supports the Bill and asks the Senior Minister of State to confirm the remaining 4% of plumbers can obtain a licence by 30 September.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: These points will benefit all Singaporeans and I stand in support of this Bill.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I understand that the interim period given to plumbers to undergo training for the new licence is six months from 1 April to 30 September this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Senior Minister of State had mentioned earlier that 96% of plumbers will be able to obtain their new licence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But can the Senior Minister of State also confirm that the other 4% will be able to complete their training and obtain a new licence by the deadline of 30 September?

sections.label: Builder Certificate licensing condition
sections.summary: One licensing condition is that plumbers must have BCA Academy's Builder Certificate for plumbing and pipe fitting.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: One of the licensing conditions is that they must have BCA Academy’s Builder Certificate for plumbing and pipe fitting.

sections.label: Plumbers obtaining licence qualifications
sections.summary: Over 96% of 863 existing plumbers have obtained LP qualifications, over 70% of qualified plumbers are aged 50 and above, and the rest will complete courses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As noted in my opening speech earlier, to date, over 96% of the 863 existing plumbers, who are either LWSPs or plumbers registered with SPS, have already obtained the qualifications to become LPs when the legislation comes into effect.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, among the 800-odd plumbers who have qualified to become LPs, more than 70% are aged 50 and above.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Of the remaining plumbers, around 10 will complete the Builder Certificate course by the middle of this year and around 20 will need to successfully undergo PUB’s two- or three-day inhouse conversion course.

sections.label: Builder Certificate course subsidies
sections.summary: A variety of subsidies, such as the SkillsFuture Mid-career Enhanced Subsidy, may offset up to 85% of Builder Certificate course fees.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For the Builder Certificate course, a variety of subsidies may be used to offset up to 85% of course fees, such as the SkillsFuture Mid-career Enhanced Subsidy.

sections.label: Enforcement against unlicensed plumber
sections.summary: Enforcement action will be taken against the unlicensed plumber and the consumer.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Enforcement action will be taken against the unlicensed plumber and the consumer.

sections.label: Licensed plumber supervision duties
sections.summary: LPs may use unlicensed plumbers but must supervise and sign off on their works, and are responsible for non-compliance with PUB standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: While LPs can do so, they must directly supervise and sign off on the works carried out by the unlicensed plumber.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Should there be any non-compliance with the requirements and standards stipulated by PUB, the LP who signed off on the works would be held responsible.

sections.label: Licensed plumbers refresher courses
sections.summary: LPs must attend PUB's refresher courses once every three years to keep abreast of the latest industry standards.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To answer Mr Louis Ng, LPs are also required to attend PUB's refresher courses once every three years to be kept abreast of the latest industry standards.
